lemmas.name: VSCore3.ProofSupport.apply_ite
lemmas.signature: ∀ {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (f : α → β) (p : Prop) [Decidable p] (x y : α), f (if p then x else y) = if p then f x else f y

lemmas.name: VSCore3.ProofSupport.apply_bool_ite
lemmas.signature: ∀ {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (f : α → β) (b : Bool) (x y : α), f (if b then x else y) = if b then f x else f y

lemmas.name: VSCore3.ProofSupport.ite_decide
lemmas.signature: ∀ {α : Sort u} (p : Prop) [Decidable p] (x y : α), (if decide p then x else y) = if p then x else y

lemmas.name: VSCore3.ProofSupport.map_identity
lemmas.signature: ∀ {α : Type u} (xs : List α), xs.map (fun x => x) = xs

lemmas.name: VSCore3.ProofSupport.int_ofNat_add
lemmas.signature: ∀ (m n : Nat), Int.ofNat (m + n) = Int.ofNat m + Int.ofNat n

lemmas.name: VSCore3.ProofSupport.to_eq_iff
lemmas.signature: ∀ {t : VSCore3.Shape} {α : Type} (a : VSCore3.Adapter t α) (x y : α), a.to x = a.to y ↔ x = y

lemmas.name: VSCore3.ProofSupport.decide_to_eq
lemmas.signature: ∀ {t : VSCore3.Shape} {α : Type} (a : VSCore3.Adapter t α) [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq (VSCore3.Denote t)] (x y : α), decide (a.to x = a.to y) = decide (x = y)

lemmas.name: VSCore3.ProofSupport.map_transport
lemmas.signature: ∀ {t u : VSCore3.Shape} {α β : Type} (a : VSCore3.Adapter t α) (b : VSCore3.Adapter u β) (f : α → β) (g : VSCore3.Denote t → VSCore3.Denote u) (h : ∀ x, g (a.to x) = b.to (f x)) (xs : List α), (VSCore3.listAdapter b).inv (List.map g ((VSCore3.listAdapter a).to xs)) = List.map f xs

lemmas.name: VSCore3.ProofSupport.filter_transport
lemmas.signature: ∀ {t : VSCore3.Shape} {α : Type} (a : VSCore3.Adapter t α) (p : α → Bool) (q : VSCore3.Denote t → Bool) (h : ∀ x, q (a.to x) = p x) (xs : List α), (VSCore3.listAdapter a).inv (List.filter q ((VSCore3.listAdapter a).to xs)) = List.filter p xs

lemmas.name: VSCore3.ProofSupport.foldl_transport
lemmas.signature: ∀ {t u : VSCore3.Shape} {α β : Type} (a : VSCore3.Adapter t α) (b : VSCore3.Adapter u β) (f : β → α → β) (g : VSCore3.Denote u → VSCore3.Denote t → VSCore3.Denote u) (h : ∀ z x, g (b.to z) (a.to x) = b.to (f z x)) (z : β) (xs : List α), b.inv (List.foldl g (b.to z) ((VSCore3.listAdapter a).to xs)) = List.foldl f z xs
